Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 15:20:00 +0000
Subject: Recap + SOC2 packet shared — next steps for Aventis

Hi Maya — thanks again for the 30-min call today. Quick recap and agreed next steps so we have the same page:

- Goal: Replace legacy inference endpoints with Redwood to cut per-token cost and reduce tail latency for interactive support features.
- Primary constraints: SOC2 evidence for security review, data retention controls, and a predictable SLA for peak hours.
- Success metric: <=100ms P50 inference latency for 95% of requests + 30% token cost reduction vs current infra.

What I shared (attached): Redwood_SOC2_Packet_v2.pdf — includes SOC2 summary, data handling, encryption, and example audit logs.

Next steps we agreed:
1) You to share list of any high-priority compliance questions (security team) — target by 1/16.
2) We’ll prepare a short technical appendix on data retention and audit export (Monica/Aditya).
3) If no blockers, proposed pilot start window: early Feb.

If useful, I can do a 20-min walkthrough of the packet with your security reviewer — happy to slot this week.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake

Hi Jordan — apologies for the slow reply, security has been heads-down this week. Thanks for the packet and for looping Monica and Aditya in. A few notes from our reviewers:

- Retention: need a clear statement of default retention for logs and a configuration matrix (we need to show legal/policy what can be changed per environment).
- Audit exports: reviewers asked for an example CSV/JSON export and a short description of fields (user id, request_id, timestamp, model_version, token_count).
- Key management: can you confirm if Redwood supports customer-managed keys via AWS KMS and whether HSM-backed keys are available for dedicated/private customers?

Those are our three blockers for an approval sign-off. If you can send a one-pager + example export, that will help. Alternatively, we can do a 30-min sync this week — 11:00 or 16:00 PT work for us on Thu/ Fri.

Thanks — Maya Singh
Director of Platform Security | Aventis Analytics
